title: Confident is not correct
caption: Polished and sure, with one line wrong. You check it, as with any new hire.

invented-sources-defended.description: In a New York federal case, lawyers filed a brief citing six cases ChatGPT had invented, defended them when challenged and were fined; the court held that the rules “impose a gatekeeping role on attorneys to ensure the accuracy of their filings”.[1]

mata-v-avianca.title: Judge P. Kevin Castel, Mata v. Avianca, Inc., Opinion and Order, No. 22-cv-1461 (PKC) (S.D.N.Y. June 22, 2023), ECF 54

wrong-answers-read-as-coherent.description: On the BCG task outside the model’s frontier, AI users’ wrong answers read as coherent, which made errors harder to catch.[1]

jagged-technological-frontier.title: Dell’Acqua, McFowland, Mollick, Lifshitz-Assaf, Kellogg, Rajendran, Krayer, Candelon, Lakhani, Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier

a-check-can-be-cheap.description: A 19-item surgical checklist was associated with inpatient death falling from 1.5% to 0.8% across eight hospitals. A before-and-after study, and not AI evidence; it shows a simple check can work.[1]

surgical-safety-checklist.title: Haynes et al., A Surgical Safety Checklist to Reduce Morbidity and Mortality in a Global Population, New England Journal of Medicine 360(5), 2009

the-profile-again.title: The profile again
the-profile-again.keywords: knowledgeable, confident, eager to please, polished work that may be wrong
the-profile-again.script: Go back to the profile for a second. Knowledgeable, confident, eager to please. That is a wonderful combination, and a dangerous one. It hands you polished work that may be wrong, and it hands it over with a smile.

you-check-as-with-any-new-hire.title: You check, as with any new hire
you-check-as-with-any-new-hire.keywords: spot-check the first drafts, where a number came from, you are responsible
you-check-as-with-any-new-hire.script: So you check it, exactly as you would with any new hire. Spot-check the first drafts. Ask where a number came from. Because whatever goes to the CEO, you are the one responsible. Not the newcomer.
